tasks.label: Build syncer_wasm + sync to pkg/
tasks.command: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg=web_sys_unstable_apis' wasm-pack build --release --target web && cp pkg/syncer_wasm.js pkg/syncer_wasm_bg.wasm pkg/syncer_wasm.d.ts pkg/syncer_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts "${workspaceFolder}/pkg/" && if [ -d pkg/snippets ]; then rsync -a --delete pkg/snippets/ "${workspaceFolder}/pkg/snippets/"; fi && echo "✓ synced syncer_wasm artifacts to ${workspaceFolder}/pkg"
